title: Journey kit
summary: patcher/journeys/support.mjs launches the built app for patch journeys: a throwaway HOME and T3CODE_HOME seeded with the release launch fixture, Chromium's mock keychain, no Dock icon and no window ever shown or focused (a journey fails if one is), telemetry and auto-update off, logs and screenshots into $T3_PATCHER_EVIDENCE. Every other patch's journeys use it. T3's browser tests run in full headless Chromium, which draws frames on a locked Mac.

journeys.name: app_opens
journeys.proves: The built app opens on an isolated home, lists the seeded thread in the sidebar and shows its message when opened.
